stock.description: Asia Financial Holdings Limited specializes in offering both general and life insurance coverage within the regions of Hong Kong, Macau, and Mainland China. Its operational structure is divided into two primary segments: Insurance and Corporate. Beyond its core insurance business, the company also engages in the trading and holding of securities, provides financing for mortgage loans, acts as a nominee, and offers various healthcare services. Furthermore, it actively participates in real estate investment ventures. Established in 1991, the firm's principal office is situated in Central, Hong Kong. Asia Financial Holdings Limited operates as a subsidiary of Claremont Capital Holdings Ltd.
